launcher.requestTimeoutHint: Timeout, retries and proxy take effect after restartin' the launcher.
launcher.proxyHint: Fer example http://proxy.local:8080. Leave empty to use the system proxy.
launcher.curseforgeApiKeyHint: Optional. Replaces the key this build came with. Network and API changes take effect after a restart.

java.automatic: Automatic (best match fer the game version)
java.autoDownloadHint: Fetch Mojang's Java runtime when no installed Java fits the game.
java.memoryRange: Minimum memory must not be more than maximum memory.
java.memoryOverTotal: More than this computer has ({{gib}} GiB); the game won't set sail.

commands.preLaunchHint: Runs before the game; if it fails, the voyage be called off. Available as variables: $INST_NAME, $INST_ID, $INST_DIR, $INST_MC_DIR, $INST_JAVA.
commands.wrapperHint: Prefixes the Java invocation, e.g. mangohud or prime-run.

tools.jprofilerPathHint: The installation folder that holds bin/jpenable.
tools.visualvmHint: Leave empty to look fer jvisualvm or visualvm on the PATH.
tools.textEditorHint: Command that opens ship files, fer example code or subl. Leave empty to use the default app.
